{"edits": [{"finding_ids": ["pydantic_cli/__init__.py:348:deprecated-method"], "search": "    field: pydantic.fields.ModelField,", "replace": "    field: pydantic.fields.FieldInfo,", "explanation": "`pydantic.fields.ModelField` was a Pydantic v1 internal class and no longer exists in Pydantic v2, so the module fails at import time (the reported AttributeError). In v2, `cls.model_fields` values are `pydantic.fields.FieldInfo` instances, so the annotation is corrected to that. This only changes the annotation; it does not alter runtime behavior."}], "notes": "The reported collection failure is the `pydantic.fields.ModelField` annotation on `_add_pydantic_field_to_parser`, which is fixed by the edit above. The previously applied `__fields__` -> `model_fields` change is kept.

Not addressed in this edit (outside the reported failure and the listed finding, and would need semantic rewrites rather than renames). These will still fail at runtime when the function is called, though not at import/collection time:
- `field.required`, `field.default`, `field.allow_none`, `field.type_`, `field.shape`: these are v1 ModelField attributes. In v2, FieldInfo has `is_required()`, `default`, and no `allow_none`/`type_`/`shape`. Type and shape info need to come from the annotation.
- `pydantic.fields.SHAPE_LIST` / `SHAPE_SET`: removed in v2.
- `cls.schema()` in `_runner` and `cls.validate(opts)` in `_runner`: deprecated in v2 (`model_json_schema()` and `model_validate()` respectively). These are not covered by the current findings, so I left them unchanged.

I recommend a follow-up pass on these, since they are v1 APIs that will fail the tests once the module loads."}]"}
